name: list_connector_project_connections
description:
List the projects connected to a connector and the environments where each connection is available.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/connect/connectors/{connector}/projects --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

connector.description: Stable connector ID or URL-encoded team-scoped UID. Examples: `scl_abc123` or `slack%2Fmy-bot`.

cursor.description: Cursor from `pagination.next` on the previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of project connections to return. Defaults to 50.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
